lines: Oh man, my bad, my bad. Took me a while to get back.
With an apologetic look, I returned to the spot where everyone was resting.
It was about 1 hour after we had escaped through the entrance gate of Yomihara.
We had avoided the territory of the Armed Refugees just in case, and we were heading back above ground using the same way we had come.
You're late, Fuma. I thought you had been eaten by a worm while you were taking a leak.
C'mon now, even I'm not that stupid.
We were in the middle of taking a breather in the darkness of the old mine shafts.
While we were resting out of concern for Sago-san's body, I had just returned from taking a piss and dealing with another errand.
Welcome back, Fuma-chan. Heberyone was just talking about how hard it's been.
Ahh, you mean our mission? Yeah, now that we've made it this far, it might as well be mission accomplished.
Yeah!! I almost died so many times! It's all thanks to Ms. Yamata no Orochi～
Shikanosuke smiled at the female Oni mercenary.
Having made it through that deadly situation together, he somehow seemed to be feeling more at ease with her.
Hm-hm... Don't worry about it. I'm a mercenary, you know. I won't complain as long as I get paid.
There you go again～ You're too modest!! No need to always act so cool.
I was the only one who didn't join in with them.
...That's right. We made it thanks to you. But I wanted to ask you something, Yamata no Orochi.
Oh, what is it, Fuma kid? Would you like to ask my measurements?
Hehe, I'd be interested in that as well. But... what I want to ask about right now is regarding the attack on our hideout.
The female warrior's attitude suddenly turned cold.
It was a minor change that probably only I would have noticed.
I kept thinking about how something like that could have happened.
How...? The UFS set those monsters on us, didn't they? Because they can't enter Yomihara themselves.
―Even if they did, how did they know where the hideout was?
That's because... someone followed us on our way there or something like that?
That's unlikely. No one was following us at that time. I'm sure of it.
We had moved with great caution when we had made our way to the hideout.
Then... someone let something slip by accident?
No chance of that either. I trust Shizuru.
She's a professional in undercover missions, there's no way she'd make a mistake that would give away the hideout.
Exactly... In that case, the remaining possibilities were limited.
It was clearly not amicable laughter. Rather, it was hostile, or perhaps it was laughter hiding the menace of sinister lunacy.
That is what I wanted to ask you, Yamata no Orochi―
Was it you who set us up?
